claims.claim: Successful non-replayed AUTHOR_REPAIR canonicalization exposes a deterministic post-canonicalization REPAIR wakeup handoff with repair_dispatch_id, failed_run_id, and canonical repair_sha.
The REPAIR handoff is dispatched after canonicalization success within the ingress workflow, preventing stranding from original issue-opened event scheduling.
Failed ingress and replayed/idempotent AUTHOR_REPAIR delivery suppress handoff outputs and prevent duplicate REPAIR continuation execution.
Non-target [AIOS BRAIN INGRESS] events skip the dedicated repair wakeup carrier receipt step without generating misleading failures, and carrier rejection receipts remain bounded to transport status.
Non-REPAIR ingress, publication dispatch, REPAIR authorization binding, and mutation authority boundaries remain behaviorally compatible.
Focused deterministic regressions reproduce the Issue #140 ordering topology, verify the single post-canonicalization handoff and duplicate suppression, and pass with zero unresolved items.
